The '''Hangshan sector''' was a part of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It contained the [[Artesia system/Legends|Artesia]], [[Erai system/Legends|Erai]], and [[Ulda Frav system/Legends|Ulda Frav systems]]. By [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], the latter [[Star system/Legends|star system]] lay in the area known as the "civilized [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]" that had been widely [[Scout/Legends|explored]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and around that [[Time/Legends|time]], it was located on a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that connected it to the [[Attahox system/Legends|Attahox]] and [[Belasco system/Legends|Belasco systems]]. At some point long before [[3956 BBY]], the ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] carried out a [[bombardment of the third moon of Erai]].

==Description==
The Hangshan [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was located in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="Slice" /> By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it bordered the [[Hocatar sector/Legends|Hocatar]] and [[Tolemses sector/Legends|Tolemses sectors]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]] and in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]] direction formed a four-way border with the [[Harron Marches/Legends|Harron Marches]] and the [[Askarian sector/Legends|Askarian]] and [[Serathrace sector/Legends|Serathrace sectors]]. The Hangshan sector contained the [[Artesia system/Legends|Artesia]], [[Erai system/Legends|Erai]], and [[Ulda Frav system/Legends|Ulda Frav systems]].<ref name="Expansion" />

==Locations==
[[File:Artesia.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Hangshan sector contained the Artesia, Erai, and Ulda Frav systems.]]
The Hangshan sector contained<ref name="EAOC systems">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Artesia system/Legends|Artesia]], [[Erai system/Legends|Erai]], [[Nazzri system/Legends|Nazzri]], and [[Ulda Frav system/Legends|Ulda Frav systems]]</ref> the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Artesia]]&mdash;on which the art form known as [[Artesian space collage]] originated<ref name="CSWECite">{{CSWECite|I|43|Artesian space collage}}</ref>&mdash;and [[Ulda Frav]].<ref name="TOTJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref> By [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], the latter was situated in the area known as the "civilized [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]" that had been widely [[Scout/Legends|explored]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and between that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] and [[3996 BBY]], Ulda Frav lay on a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that connected it to the [[Attahox system/Legends|Attahox]] and [[Belasco system/Legends|Belasco systems]]. However, the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route had ceased to exist by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Mandalorian Wars]] of [[3976 BBY]]&ndash;[[3960 BBY]].<ref name="TEA Ulda Frav">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Ulda Frav system/Legends|Ulda Frav system]]</ref>

At some point before the [[Freedon Nadd Uprising]]<ref name="TOTJC" /> of [[3998 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> a group of several [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] arbitrated a treaty on Ulda Frav. There, they encountered [[Prince/Legends|Crown Prince]] [[Qrrrl Toq]] of the isolated<ref name="TOTJC" /> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC systems" /> planet [[Nazzri]], who was visiting Ulda Frav as part of his self-imposed [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] known as [[boqeri]]. The [[Nazzar/Legends|Nazzar]] subsequently joined the Jedi on their return journey to the planet [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]],<ref name="TOTJC" /> the Outer Rim Territories headquarters of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. As part of the [[Krath Holy Crusade]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] of 3996 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], the military forces of the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] cult passed through the Ulda Frav [[Star system/Legends|system]] before [[Battle of the Attahox system|confronting]] the [[Republic Military/Legends|forces]] of the Republic in the Attahox system.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

On the [[third moon of Erai]],<ref name="KOTOR" /> which was situated in the Hangshan sector's Erai system,<ref name="EAOC systems" /> [[Eralam]] [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]] were [[Mining/Legends|mined]] at some point long before<ref name="KOTOR" /> [[3956 BBY]].<ref name="KOTORdate">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' to [[3956 BBY]].</ref> When the ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Bombardment of the third moon of Erai|bombarded]] the [[Moon/Legends|moon]], much of what remained there became shattered, with the [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] becoming exceedingly rare.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hangshan sector was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> In [[2012]], the sector was depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in the Online Companion feature "[https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region]," which placed it in grid square P-11.<ref name="Expansion" />
